chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq al-Talaqani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Sa'id al-Hamadani, the servant of Banu Hashim, narrated to us, saying: Al-Mundhir b. Muhammad informed us, saying: Ja'far b. Isma'il al-Bazzaz al-Kufi narrated to me, saying: Abdullah b. al-Fadl narrated to me, from Thabit b. Dinar, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Abdullah b. Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

He who denies the Imamate of Ali after me is like him who denied my prophethood during my lifetime; and he who denies my prophethood is like him who denies the lordship of his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.إمامة: Imamah - Imamate: the divinely appointed leadership of the Muslim community after the Prophet
key_terms.ربوبية: Rububiyyah - Lordship: God's attribute of absolute sovereignty over all creation
key_terms.نبوة: Nubuwwah - Prophethood: the divine mission and authority bestowed upon messengers of God

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about denying the Imamate of Ali in al-Amali of al-Saduq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Saduq, the Prophet Muhammad (s) delivers a powerful creedal declaration linking the denial of Imam Ali's Imamate to the denial of his own prophethood, and the denial of his prophethood to the denial of God's lordship. This establishes a three-tiered theological hierarchy — God's lordship, Muhammad's prophethood, and Ali's Imamate — as inseparable articles of faith. The hadith is transmitted through a chain of eight narrators ending with Abdullah ibn Abbas, one of the Prophet's most learned companions.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq al-Talaqani (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Sa`id al-Hamadani the servant of Bani Hashim narrated to us. He said: Al-Mundhir b. Muhammad informed us. He said: Ja`far b. Isma`il al-Bazzaz al-Kufi narrated to me. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Fadl narrated to me from Thabit b. Dinar from Sa`id b. Jubayr from `Abdullah b. `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
He who denies the Imamate of `Ali after me is like him who denies my prophethood in my lifetime; and he who denies my prophethood is like him who denies the lordship of his Lord.
